# Vendored tfl-ts (historical)

tfl-ts-2.15.3-stops-e065ff3.tgz was a pnpm pack of a local tfl-ts bus stop index branch at e065ff3 (tfl-ts 2.15.3 + tfl-ts/meta/stops). The app now depends on published `tfl-ts@^2.16.0`, which ships `tfl-ts/meta/stops`. Keep this archive only as a fallback reference; do not point package.json at the file: tarball.
